tools.name: search_telegram
tools.description: Full-text search over the tgden catalog (1.8M+ channels, 457k+ group chats, 228k+ bots) with subscriber/member counts, categories and trust scores. Needs no Telegram account — this is the public catalog, so it finds communities the user has NOT joined. Use type to restrict to one entity kind.

tools.name: channel_stats
tools.description: Full record for one channel by @username: subscribers, category, language, trust score, description.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the tgden Telegram catalog (channels, group chats, bots). ChatGPT deep-research compatible; for counts, categories and trust scores use search_telegram

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read one result of `search` by its id as a document: title, description, audience size, categories and the tgden.com page

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_telegram" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
